questions.text: Which Greek goddess shares her name with a famous sportswear brand?
questions.explanation: Nike was the Greek goddess of victory.

questions.text: In myth, which creature has the head of a bull and the body of a man?
questions.explanation: The Minotaur was imprisoned in the Labyrinth on Crete.

questions.text: Who in Greek myth opened a jar that released troubles into the world?
questions.explanation: Pandora's jar (often called a box) released evils, leaving only hope.

questions.text: Which Norse god wields the hammer Mjolnir?
questions.explanation: Thor is the Norse god of thunder and wields Mjolnir.

questions.text: What is the holy book of Islam?
questions.explanation: The Quran is the central religious text of Islam.

questions.text: In Roman mythology, who is the god of war?
questions.explanation: Mars was the Roman god of war, equivalent to the Greek Ares.

questions.text: Which Hindu god is depicted with the head of an elephant?
questions.explanation: Ganesha is the elephant-headed son of Shiva and Parvati.

questions.text: Which hero of Greek myth completed twelve labours?
questions.explanation: Heracles, known to the Romans as Hercules, performed twelve labours.

questions.text: Which river must the dead cross to reach the underworld in Greek myth?
questions.explanation: The Styx was the river separating the living world from Hades.

questions.text: Which festival marks the Jewish New Year?
questions.explanation: Rosh Hashanah opens the Jewish High Holy Days.

questions.text: Which sorceress in Homer's Odyssey turns Odysseus' men into pigs?
questions.explanation: Circe lived on the island of Aeaea.

questions.text: Which Egyptian god of embalming and the dead is shown with a jackal's head?
questions.explanation: Anubis was the jackal-headed god of mummification.

questions.text: Which river is considered the holiest in Hinduism?
questions.explanation: The Ganges is revered as the goddess Ganga.

questions.text: In Norse myth, what is the name of the enormous tree that links the nine worlds?
questions.explanation: Yggdrasil is the world tree of Norse cosmology.

questions.text: Which term describes the state of release from rebirth in Buddhism?
questions.explanation: Nirvana is the extinguishing of craving and the end of rebirth.

spares.text: Which winged horse is a famous creature of Greek myth?
spares.explanation: Pegasus sprang from the blood of Medusa.

spares.text: Which mountain was the home of the Greek gods?
spares.explanation: The twelve Olympians were said to live on Mount Olympus.

spares.text: Which Titan was punished for stealing fire for humanity?
spares.explanation: Zeus chained Prometheus to a rock as punishment.
